_comment: GENERATED by tools/gen-listing.mjs. ram and io addresses are main-CPU addresses (sound $0000-$03FF = main $6000-$63FF); io keys prefixed "sub:" / "sound:" are in that CPU's space.

ram_comments.sub_handshake: boot: $11 main->sub, $22 sub done; $33 at game start
ram_comments.entry_blank_ptr: name entry: 3 cells blanked a frame once the cursor passes the last field
ram_comments.entry_rank: name entry: rank of the new entry, counted down while shifting
ram_comments.demo_timer: frames left for this demo input
ram_comments.stats_blank_count: operator stats: frame counter, blanks the text every 8th
ram_comments.var_0C00: $0C00-$0C03: written only by the dead code at $D04C
ram_comments.bonus_second: bonus life: second threshold, BCD x 10000
ram_comments.bonus_every: bonus life: every further one, BCD x 10000 (0 = none)
ram_comments.stage_text_timer: stage start text timer; service mode: the sound-test number (was var_100A)
ram_comments.frame_counter: +1 per main IRQ; also the game's randomness
ram_comments.fire_held: fire button held (edge detection for task_player_fire)
ram_comments.stage_params: load_stage_params: $1036 attack counts, $103A trio thresholds, $1042/$104A group thresholds, $1052 dive paths
ram_comments.boss_bonus_idx: index into boss_bonus_sprites, +1 per boss hit
ram_comments.shots_to_clear: shots that hit this pass: b0 slot 1, b1 slot 2 (stored, not OR-ed)
ram_comments.stage_setup_pass: task_stage_setup: 0 = template pass, else layout pass
ram_comments.formation_path_ptr: formation path, 4-byte steps, restarts at formation_path on $FF
ram_comments.formation_slot: sub: index of the slot task_formation_move works on ($FF = none)
ram_comments.ready_timer: the current player's ready timer (copy of $1023/$1024)
ram_comments.group1_index: launch group 1: next position of dat_FC09 (0-$13)
ram_comments.trio_free_count: trio launches: free formation slots counted
ram_comments.shot_ptr: task_shot_hits: pointer to the shot flag being tested
ram_comments.hit_diving: task_shot_hits: the hit enemy was diving (type for $110B)
ram_comments.hitbox: task_shot_hits: shot box y max, y min, x max, x min; alias hit_box
ram_comments.hit_xhi: task_shot_hits: the shot's X bit 8 (screen half)
ram_comments.capture_anim_idx: index into dat_E6F9, step 2, wraps at $30
ram_comments.shot_slots_end: end of the player shot slots ($0EA6, or $0EA8)
ram_comments.player_frozen: non-zero: the player cannot move (capture, effects)
ram_comments.player_dying: non-zero while the player dies (sounds gated)
ram_comments.effect_pos: position (Y, X) of the requested effect
ram_comments.effect_flags: flags ($80 | type) of the requested effect
ram_comments.player_exploding: the player explosion is running; alias player_hit
ram_comments.boss_chain: boss hit chain: 1, doubled per boss hit up to $40
ram_comments.hit_points: score multiplier of the last hit (boss_chain, or 1-4 by row)
ram_comments.bonus_obj_count: countdown ($32) during which shots flip pictures
ram_comments.object_state: sub: state of the 4 objects ($0EE2 + 10k), object_states
ram_comments.ready_active: 1 while READY counts; also $55 = formation attacks allowed (sub $B385)
ram_comments.formation_end: end of the formation scan ($188D after stage start)
ram_comments.p1_saved_mode: player 1's game_mode saved at a turn switch
ram_comments.p2_saved_mode: player 2's game_mode saved at a turn switch
ram_comments.boss_chain_timer: $20 after a boss hit, counts down; at 0 the chain restarts
ram_comments.results_delay: results screen: frames before the next step
ram_comments.results_hits_left: results screen: hit markers still to draw
ram_comments.results_count: hits counted in the challenging stage / results
ram_comments.clear_delay: frames before the next mode once the stage is empty
ram_comments.entry_char_index: name entry: index into the current field's alphabet
ram_comments.entry_repeat: name entry: stick auto-repeat delay (8 frames)
ram_comments.star_dir_flags: starfield direction mode for irq_starfield (0-2); alias event_star_mode
ram_comments.bonus_ship_out: the bonus ship has appeared this stage
ram_comments.shot_fired_flags: one per formation member ($1A10-$1A51): shot already fired
ram_comments.p1_saved_formation: player 1's formation flags saved at a turn switch
ram_comments.p2_saved_formation: player 2's formation flags saved at a turn switch
ram_comments.snd_request: sound n: main writes 1 (sound: boot handshake at +0)
ram_comments.wsg_shadow: per voice: vol, f lo, f mid, f hi|wave
